name: mirage
text: That ParlayAPI warning was wrong, and I know why: the engine only re-reads each key's plan once an hour, so right after you upgraded to Pro it was still counting the Pro key as a spent free key and judged only your two Starter keys (14,740 credits). Its 00:14 UTC read found the Pro key at 98,936 of 100,000 and the warning is gone. The fix is in the API monitor rebuild I am doing now: every API's account is re-read every few minutes (free reads), so a plan change or a refused key shows up within minutes and a warning is checked against fresh figures first. The Odds API warning (6,803 credits left, resets in 11 days) is a different, real pace warning: it spent 508 credits today; tell me if you want it rested.
